title: Turbo Treats
tagline: Sugar-rush coins, spin-out oil slicks, and a trail of gumdrops behind the leader.
pitch: Turbo Treats: a candy kart race where coins give a sugar-rush speed boost, oil puddles spin you out, and the leader leaves a trail of gumdrops. Sweet pastel colours, three laps.
controls: W / up: throttle, S / down: brake
Space (hold while steering): drift, release = boost

mechanics.name: rule
mechanics.snippet: K.Mechanics.rule(game, {"name": "Sugar Rush", "text": "12 sugar coins = SUGAR RUSH: 4 seconds of 1.5x speed.", "when": "state", "key": "collected", "gte": 12, "do": [{"tune": {"speed": 1.5}, "seconds": 4}, {"banner": "SUGAR RUSH!"}, {"score": 50}, {"fx": "speedLines"}, {"sfx": "boost"}]});

Gumdrops of the Leader

plan.title: Turbo Treats
plan.tagline: Sugar-rush coins, spin-out oil slicks, and a trail of gumdrops behind the leader.
plan.core_loop: Lap a candy circuit against 3 AI karts, grabbing sugar coins to charge a sugar-rush speed boost, dodging oil slicks that spin you out, and snatching gumdrops from the leader's trail to overtake.
controls: R: reset to the racing line
plan.win_condition: Finish 3 laps ahead of the 3 AI karts (1st place at the finish gantry).
plan.lose_condition: Finish 4th — the candy shop closes and you get a lollipop consolation.

mechanics.name: Sugar Rush
mechanics.text: 12 sugar coins = SUGAR RUSH: 4 seconds of 1.5x speed.

mechanics.name: Oil Slick Spin-Out
mechanics.text: Cross an oil slick and your kart spins out — dizzy wobble, no steering for a second.

mechanics.name: Gumdrops of the Leader
mechanics.text: The leader leaves a trail of gumdrops; trailing karts can pick them up for a boost.

plan.art_direction: Glossy toon Candy Land: bubblegum pink, mint, lemon and caramel palette with thick ink outlines; candy-glass materials, candy-cane striped curbs, gumdrop bumpers and a lemon-yellow sun. Bright high-noon light with cotton-candy clouds, cheerful arcade-kart mood — Candy Land meets a retro kart racer.
concept_shots: The pink bunny kart drifts a banked corner, candy-cane curbs and a glowing trail of gumdrops behind it, a mint AI kart chasing on the inside line.
Sugar rush: the kart blurs down the straight with speed lines, sugar coins streaking past, cotton-candy clouds and a lemon sun behind.
A kart hits an oil slick and spins out in a dizzy wobble while gumdrops bounce off the candy barriers and the leader's trail glistens ahead.

assets.sky: High-noon candy sky: cotton-candy clouds in pink, peach and cream, soft lemon-yellow sun, horizon fading to mint.

features: Oil slicks (spinner hazards) scattered on the racing line — hitting one spins the kart out with a wobble and a splat sound
Gumdrops of the leader: the leading kart leaves a trail of glowing gumdrops that trailing karts can pick up for a small boost
Boost pads on the straights with speed-lines FX and a boost sfx
Candy-cane curbs and striped barriers with sparkle FX when a kart clips them
Sugar-rush meter in the HUD: 12 coins fills it and triggers a 4s 1.5x speed burst with speed lines
Confetti burst at the finish gantry and a podium banner showing final placement
plan.mapping_notes: Candy kart race → look 'candy' (glossy pastel candy preset), player_type 'kart', mode 'race', level_kind 'race_track' (the only preset built for kart racing: closed banked circuit with curbs, barriers, start/finish gantry, boost pads, lake infield), camera 'chase', race {laps: 3, opponents: 3} for the AI karts. 'Coins give a sugar-rush speed boost' → collectible tag 'coin' labelled Sugar Coins (40 placed along the racing line, target 12) plus the 'Sugar Rush' count rule: 12 coins → 4s of 1.5x speed with banner and speed lines. 'Oil puddles spin you out' → the catalog has no literal oil puddle, so Gameplay.HAZARDS 'spinner' stands in as the puddle footprint and the 'Oil Slick Spin-Out' custom mechanic codes the spin-out: a dizzy wobble, splat sfx and a lost second of steering. 'The leader leaves a trail of gumdrops' → 'Gumdrops of the Leader' custom mechanic: the current leader's kart gets an FX trail of glowing gumdrops and the builder spawns short-lived gumdrop pickups along it, so chasers get a boost lane — turning the leader's advantage into a pickup for everyone behind. Hero: the pitch names no protagonist, so a candy bunny (species 'bunny', accessory 'scarf') in pink/mint is the closest candy mascot. HUD is arcade style with icons for sugar coins, the rush meter (bolt), laps and placement (trophy); props are scattered gumdrops and lollipop signposts dressing the infield and barriers.

result.summary: Turbo Treats scaffold: fixed the one blocking error — the 'Sugar Rush' K.Mechanics.rule used an unsupported object form for `when` ({kind:'count', tag, gte}) which threw "unknown when.kind 'count'"; replaced it with the documented state-trigger form (when:'state', key:'collected', gte:12) so the 12-coin sugar-rush rule (4s 1.5x speed, banner, +50 score) now registers. The rest of the scaffold (candy look, generated sky/props/splats, race_track level with 40 coins, bunny kart, chase cam, 3-lap race vs 3 AI, arcade HUD, title screen, FX/Audio auto) is intact.
changes: game.js: corrected Sugar Rush rule trigger from {kind:'count',tag:'coin',gte:12} to {when:'state',key:'collected',gte:12}
known_issues: Two plan mechanics remain TODO stubs: 'Oil Slick Spin-Out' (spinner hazards exist on the level but the dizzy-wobble/no-steering custom mechanic is not implemented) and 'Gumdrops of the Leader' (leader trail + gumdrop pickups not implemented).
No twist mechanic of my own was added (required at least one).
The fix was applied but play_game was not re-run to confirm zero errors and mechanic firing before the step budget ran out.
Win/lose screens, extra FX moments (confetti at gantry, podium banner) and oil-slick visuals were not added.

incidents: a duplicate builder process of the same pipeline ran 04:48-04:52 on this run dir and was killed; game.js was not written during that window, so it most likely has none of its writes

post_stages.stage: re-recorded and re-scored after the final kit update
